subject.title: [Bug]: TLS certificate pin mismatch loop when connecting through Cloudflare Tunnel/Access (anycast edge certs)

question: What durable identity should iOS authenticate when a manually configured gateway is reached through a system-trusted reverse proxy whose leaf certificate can change between connections?
rationale: Source proves the current single-leaf model cannot support Cloudflare anycast, but choosing CA-only trust, gateway application identity, or continued strict pinning changes the remote-gateway security boundary and upgrade contract.

options.title: Dual trust model
options.body: Keep leaf pinning for direct or self-signed gateways and use system hostname/CA validation plus paired gateway identity for explicitly selected reverse-proxy endpoints.

options.title: Strict leaf pinning only
options.body: Keep the existing security model and explicitly declare rotating anycast TLS termination unsupported, leaving Cloudflare Tunnel/Access remote use blocked.

options.title: System CA trust only
options.body: Stop leaf pinning for manually configured public domains and rely solely on platform hostname and CA validation, accepting the loss of the current gateway-specific transport pin.

recommendation.title: Dual trust model
recommendation.body: Keep leaf pinning for direct or self-signed gateways and use system hostname/CA validation plus paired gateway identity for explicitly selected reverse-proxy endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history ties this person to introducing the iOS TLS identity boundary that the decision would revise.
